title: Impact of 2019 Decriminalisation of Suicide on Number of Reported Cases and on Persons Tempted to Commit Suicide
what_it_is: Impact of 2019 Decriminalisation of Suicide on Number of Reported Cases and on Persons Tempted to Commit Suicide

sections.label: Suicide deaths 2019 and 2020
sections.summary: From January to September 2019 there were 304 deaths by suicide, and preliminarily 166 such deaths from January to September 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From January to September 2019, there were 304 deaths by suicide.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Preliminarily, from January to September 2020, this year, there were 166 cases of death by suicide.

sections.label: Amendments and Police cases
sections.summary: The amendments took effect on 1 January 2020; from January to September this year Police assisted in about 1,800 cases involving suicidal ideation or possible attempts, compared with about 1,200 attempted suicide reports per year from 2017 to 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The amendments came into effect on 1 January 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From January to September this year, Police were called to assist in about 1,800 cases involving persons with suicidal ideation or persons who may have attempted suicide.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Before attempted suicide was decriminalised, from 2017 to 2019, Police received about 1,200 reports of attempted suicide per year.

sections.label: Decriminalisation and suicide prevention efforts
sections.summary: The criminal justice system is not the best way to deal with persons who attempted suicide, and decriminalisation reduces stigma and encourages early help-seeking, so the Government continues efforts to prevent suicides and will monitor and adjust approaches.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The criminal justice system is not the best way to deal with persons who attempted suicide.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The decriminalisation of attempted suicide reduces stigma and encourages persons who are suicidal to seek help early.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Hence, the Government has been continuing our efforts to prevent suicides.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the situation and adjust our approaches to better assist suicidal persons.
